$schema-note: Directory data for Data Recover Free. Modeled on the legacy MySQL schema (softwares/categories/os tables). To add an entry, append an object to `entries` and bump `version`. Fields: id (unique slug; for S2 suite tools use the s2-file-id.js program key so the identifier widget can highlight them), name, description, categories (array of category ids from `categories`), os (array of os ids from `oses`), license, homepage (URL), source (optional URL), tags (free-form search keywords).

entries.name: Universal File Repair Tool
entries.description: One tool that tries every applicable S2 recovery strategy on any damaged file: identifies the format, then routes it through the right repair passes. Good first stop when you do not know what is wrong.

entries.name: CorruptDOCXRepair
entries.description: Repairs corrupt Word .docx files by rebuilding the OOXML package: recovers the ZIP container, fixes damaged XML parts, and reassembles a document Word will open.

entries.name: Quick Word Recovr
entries.description: Fast, minimal recovery for damaged .docx files: extracts the main document text quickly when a full structural repair is not needed.

entries.name: Word Recovery
entries.description: Recovers text and content from damaged Word files, covering both legacy binary .doc and modern .docx formats.

entries.name: Damageddocx2txt
entries.description: Salvages plain text out of severely damaged .docx files when the document can no longer be rebuilt — a last-resort text extractor.

entries.name: S2 Recovery Tools for Microsoft Excel
entries.description: Recovers corrupt .xls and .xlsx spreadsheets with six strategies (Auto, Strict Read, Lenient XML Repair, ZIP Recovery, Salvage Cells, Convert to CSV). Cross-platform PWA plus a legacy Windows deep-recovery tool.

entries.name: Excel Recovery Addin
entries.description: An Excel add-in that adds recovery routines for damaged workbooks directly inside Microsoft Excel on Windows.

entries.name: PPTX Recovery
entries.description: Repairs corrupt PowerPoint .pptx presentations entirely in the browser: rebuilds the ZIP package, repairs slide XML, and salvages slide text.

entries.name: OO Recovery
entries.description: Recovers damaged OpenDocument files (.odt, .ods, .odp, .odg) produced by OpenOffice / LibreOffice.

entries.name: Immortal Zip
entries.description: Repairs corrupt ZIP archives (and ZIP-based formats like .jar, .apk, .epub) by scanning for local file headers and inflating each entry independently — works even when the central directory is gone.

entries.name: XML Truncator-Fixer
entries.description: Fixes truncated or malformed XML — including the XML parts inside .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx packages — by closing open tags and trimming damage so parsers accept the file again.

entries.name: Savvy Repair for Microsoft Office
entries.description: One repair tool for the whole Microsoft Office family: damaged .doc, .xls, .ppt and their OOXML successors .docx, .xlsx, .pptx.

entries.name: Coffice2txt
entries.description: Extracts readable text from corrupt Office files (.doc, .xls, .ppt, .docx, .xlsx, .pptx) when full repair fails — get the words out even if the formatting is lost.

entries.name: Crrptoffcxtrctr
entries.description: Corrupt Office extractor: pulls the surviving parts (text, images, media, XML) out of damaged .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx packages.

entries.name: Saveofficedata
entries.description: Rescues data from damaged legacy Office binaries (.doc, .xls, .ppt) — the pre-2007 formats that other OOXML-focused tools skip.

entries.name: File Fixer Bot
entries.description: An assistant-style tool that walks you through diagnosing and fixing a broken file of any type, picking the right S2 strategy for you.

entries.name: Data Recover Free
entries.description: This site: a searchable directory of free and open-source data-recovery software, including the whole S2 recovery suite. Successor to the original SourceForge PHP directory.

entries.name: Previous Version Explorer
entries.description: Explores and restores Windows 'Previous Versions' (Volume Shadow Copy) snapshots of files and folders — often the fastest way to get an uncorrupted copy back.

entries.name: TestDisk
entries.description: Powerful free partition-recovery tool: fixes partition tables, recovers deleted partitions, rebuilds boot sectors, and undeletes files from FAT/NTFS/ext filesystems.

entries.name: PhotoRec
entries.description: File-carving companion to TestDisk: recovers photos, documents, and hundreds of other file types from disks and memory cards by signature, ignoring the (possibly destroyed) filesystem.

entries.name: GNU ddrescue
entries.description: Data-recovery imaging tool: copies failing disks and partitions to an image, retrying and mapping bad sectors so you rescue the maximum data from dying hardware before it is gone.

entries.name: Scalpel
entries.description: Fast, frugal file carver: recovers files from disk images by header/footer signatures. A rewrite of Foremost focused on performance and low memory use.

entries.name: Foremost
entries.description: Console file-carving program originally developed by the US Air Force Office of Special Investigations: recovers files from disk images based on their headers, footers, and internal structures.
